newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust hires Horn as private banker.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust hires Horn as private banker.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp said it hired Karen Horn, chairwoman of Bank One, Cleveland, to be head of international private banking.
Horn, who will be a managing director, will also serve as deputy head of Bankers Trust's private banking business. She will begin at Bankers Trust on October 1.
Horn has been chairwoman of Bank One, Cleveland since 1987. Bank One, Cleveland, is part of the Banc One Corp holding company headquartered in Columbus, Ohio.
Horn was president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland from 1982 to 1987, during which time she served as a member of the Federal Open Market Committee, the Fed's policy-setting group.

"Karen Horn's experience as a financial executive and her excellent record as a business builder will benefit greatly Bankers Trust's efforts to achieve global leadership in private banking," said Richard Marin, head of the Bankers Trust private banking buienes.

A spokesman for Banc One said David Stith, chief executive of Bank One, Cleveland, will assume Horn's duties as chairman when she leaves. The spokesman noted that Banc One is in the process of consolidating its 18 bank charters in Ohio into one single charter.
